Brand.name: PinSnap
Brand.tagline: Pin your photo memories on the map

Landing.heroLine1: วางรูป / Pin somewhere
Landing.subtitle: Everyone's memories, mapped. Hover a pin to peek the photo — click it to read the story.
Landing.step1: 01. Snap or paste a photo from a place you visited.
Landing.step2: 02. Drop a pin on the map — city & country auto-detected.
Landing.step3: 03. Type your field memo, date visited & travel tags.

Setup.title: Almost there!
Setup.body: This map needs a Supabase project to power it. Add your NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to .env.local, then run the SQL in supabase/schema.sql.
